extracted.name: Easy Shrimp Cocktail Sauce
extracted.description: Shrimp Cocktail is a timeless appetizer made a bold, tangy cocktail sauce from scratch, and cooked shrimp for serving. It’s the ultimate make-ahead appetizer for parties, holidays, or any occasion that calls for something quick, elegant, and delicious.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lbs large, cooked, tail-on shrimp* (, rinsed with cold water)
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to a bowl and mix well to combine.
Taste and adjust to your preference (more horseradish if you want it spicier and more ketchup if you want it mellower).
The sauce can be made ahead and refrigerated for several days in advance. Serve cold with shrimp.
categories: How to make shrimp cocktail sauce
